what: Seller discovers that Etsy's AI modified over 16 of their listing titles by inserting colons, triggering search visibility warnings on their dashboard despite never having used colons in titles.
verbatim_snippet: "Seems it was my titles, for some unknown reason, each affected one had a 'Colon' after the first few words of the title instead of the comma. I would never use : in my titles and suddenly it has appeared on over 16 of my listings? Which then affected my shop in the search visibility section. Thanks Etsy!"
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. 16+ listings affected. AI-modified titles without seller consent. Search visibility warnings triggered. Thread received multiple responses from other sellers confirming similar experiences. A later post in the same thread from the same seller notes that manually rewriting titles over a 2-week period led to noticeable increases in views and visits.
